dsh-client-ui-writing is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Client-side writing panel for the Web UI: project volumes and stats, corpus library, full-text search, evolution version-chain diffs, and an SVG thread graph, shown only in writing-preset sessions.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-fd0f67c92b2b9e8d2afe.html
